'''Vortine''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] who left his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Voss]] to visit the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]]. He also sold his wares on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and on his homeworld.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vortine appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Voss Modification Commendations Vendor on Carrick Station, though he was later relabeled as a Level 45 Modification Commendations Vendor. Like his counterpart [[Shaleen]], Vortine was not given an actual Voss name including a suffix.<ref name="TOR" />

When patch 4.0 was released on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Vortine appeared on other worlds (such as [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and [[Voss]]), replacing the original armor, weapon, and mods vendors of those planets pre-4.0.<ref name="TOR" />
